Indian naval ship INS Sudarshini participates in US naval review

The Indian naval ship INS Sudarshini has docked in New York to participate in the US International Naval Review 250 and Sail4th 250 events. These events are being held to mark the 4th of July. The ship's presence signifies India's representation at the international naval gathering.
